remarks: Ideally situated just four houses from the beach, this charming Colonial offers the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and coastal lifestyle. The inviting interior features a spacious great room, gourmet kitchen, and separate TV room. The impressive primary suite showcases a cathedral ceiling and beautifully appointed bathroom, while the additional bedrooms offer private en-suite bathrooms. A versatile loft provides additional space for guests, work, or relaxation. Enjoy the outdoors in the private yard, complete with an outdoor shower, deck, and patio. An exceptional location near the beach, this home offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy everything coastal Westport has to offer.
